title: Mnemo Phase 8.6 Candidate Source Register

candidates.document_title: राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति 2020 (National Education Policy 2020 - Hindi Version)
candidates.author_or_organization: Ministry of Education (Shiksha Mantralaya), Government of India
candidates.subdomain_or_topic: National Educational Reform, Higher Education & School Pedagogy
candidates.estimated_semantic_density: HIGH (Continuous native Hindi prose, standard institutional vocabulary)
candidates.linguistic_validation_evidence: Official Hindi policy text published by Ministry of Education; verified native Devanagari orthography with standard Hindi grammatical markers (है, हैं, किया जाएगा, के अंतर्गत).
candidates.license_details: Official Government of India Publication; released for public dissemination under National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP) principles.
candidates.risk_assessment: LOW. Native digital PDF with clean selectable text; zero OCR dependency.

candidates.document_title: भारत का संविधान (Constitution of India - Authoritative Hindi Text)

candidates.publisher: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
candidates.subdomain_or_topic: Constitutional Law, Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles, Parliamentary Framework
candidates.estimated_semantic_density: VERY HIGH (Dense legal and administrative Hindi prose, structured articles)
candidates.linguistic_validation_evidence: Authoritative Hindi text under Article 394A of the Constitution; standard formal Hindi legal register.
candidates.license_details: Statutory Law of India; reproduction permitted under Indian Copyright Act 1957 Section 52(1)(q).
candidates.risk_assessment: LOW. Clean native digital text; extensive semantic assertions across government institutions.

candidates.subdomain_or_topic: Agrarian Society, Social Realism, Rural North Indian Life
